description: Single compact fantasy RPG skill icon, crisp 16-bit pixel art, bold clean dark outline, 3 shades per color, simple readable silhouette, centered with 5 pixel empty margin, no frame, no letters, transparent background. A compact silver-rimmed blue shield facing front at center-right. One thick GOLDEN ricochet arrow hits its left edge and bends sharply back toward upper-left, clear outward triangular arrowhead. Small gold impact spark at the bend. The blue shield and golden bent returning arrow are both large and readable. No sword, no leaves, no text.
